title: Repeat Missed Appointments within Twelve Months — HomeCare Coverage Training Note
content:
*When do repeated misses raise the missed-appointment charge on a Calloway Limited Home Warranty coverage?* Through the repeat-miss multiplier, applied to the program's missed-appointment fee.

**Rule.** The repeat-miss multiplier reads the billable number together with the missed-appointment charges assessed on the coverage within the last 12 calendar months (dated later than the same calendar day 12 months before the assessment day) less the charges waived within that same window: a billable number of 3 or more while at least one such unwaived charge stands takes 1.50; a billable number of exactly 2 while at least one such unwaived charge stands takes 1.25; any other missed appointment takes 1.00, that is, no adjustment. The billable number is the missed appointment's count of missed appointments less the program's free missed appointments.

**Questions answered by the rule.**

*What counts as an unwaived charge standing in the window?* The missed-appointment charges assessed on the coverage dated later than the same calendar day 12 months before the assessment day, less the charges waived in that same window; if that difference is one or more, at least one unwaived charge stands.

*Does a charge dated exactly 12 months before the assessment day count?* No. Assessed on 15 August 2025, the window takes charges dated 16 August 2024 or later.

*What if the billable number is 1?* The multiplier is 1.00, whatever the window holds.

| Billable number | At least one unwaived missed-appointment charge in the last 12 calendar months | Repeat-miss multiplier |
|---|---|---|
| 1 or less | Yes or No | 1.00 |
| 2 | Yes | 1.25 |
| 2 | No | 1.00 |
| 3 or more | Yes | 1.50 |
| 3 or more | No | 1.00 |

**Hypothetical illustration.** Two missed-appointment charges were assessed in the window and one of them was waived: one unwaived charge stands. A missed appointment with billable number 3 then takes 1.50.
